description: Eight cars park at distinct symbolic goals. Cars 0-3 must visit gate A before their goal; cars 4-7 must visit gate B. At each gate one car waits at an adjacent queue node while another occupies the gate, then passes through it. Gate, queue, parking, start and goal locations and all optional edges are symbolic; no complete passing order is imposed.
initial_constraints: role_queue_a != role_queue_b & role_queue_a != role_gate_a & role_queue_a != role_gate_b & role_queue_b != role_gate_a & role_queue_b != role_gate_b
start_0 != role_gate_a & start_1 != role_gate_a & start_2 != role_gate_a & start_3 != role_gate_a & start_4 != role_gate_a & start_5 != role_gate_a & start_6 != role_gate_a & start_7 != role_gate_a
start_0 != role_gate_b & start_1 != role_gate_b & start_2 != role_gate_b & start_3 != role_gate_b & start_4 != role_gate_b & start_5 != role_gate_b & start_6 != role_gate_b & start_7 != role_gate_b

distance_to_goal_0 >= 2 & distance_to_goal_1 >= 2 & distance_to_goal_2 >= 2 & distance_to_goal_3 >= 2 & distance_to_goal_4 >= 2 & distance_to_goal_5 >= 2 & distance_to_goal_6 >= 2 & distance_to_goal_7 >= 2
desired_ltl: (!(loc_0 = goal_0) U (loc_0 = role_gate_a & X F (loc_0 = goal_0))) & (!(loc_1 = goal_1) U (loc_1 = role_gate_a & X F (loc_1 = goal_1))) & (!(loc_2 = goal_2) U (loc_2 = role_gate_a & X F (loc_2 = goal_2))) & (!(loc_3 = goal_3) U (loc_3 = role_gate_a & X F (loc_3 = goal_3))) & (!(loc_4 = goal_4) U (loc_4 = role_gate_b & X F (loc_4 = goal_4))) & (!(loc_5 = goal_5) U (loc_5 = role_gate_b & X F (loc_5 = goal_5))) & (!(loc_6 = goal_6) U (loc_6 = role_gate_b & X F (loc_6 = goal_6))) & (!(loc_7 = goal_7) U (loc_7 = role_gate_b & X F (loc_7 = goal_7))) & F (loc_0 = role_gate_a & adjacent_0_1 & loc_1 = role_queue_a & X (loc_1 = role_queue_a & F (loc_1 = role_gate_a))) & F (loc_4 = role_gate_b & adjacent_4_5 & loc_5 = role_queue_b & X (loc_5 = role_queue_b & F (loc_5 = role_gate_b))) & F all_parked
